jobs.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Production sprite animation atlas for Ribterra, realistic hand-painted medieval isometric settlement game, fine material detail matching natural brown/blue villagers, firewood bundles, burlap sacks and little wooden cargo carts. Generate exactly ONE 2048x1024 PNG with true transparent alpha background. Strict 8 columns by 4 rows of equally sized 256x256 cells, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO scene, NO letters, NO scenery. Each cell contains the SAME a medieval male villager, brown wool knee-length coat over a muted blue tunic, dark trousers and leather boots, short brown hair, walking freely with empty hands and natural alternating arm swing. Camera fixed orthographic looking down at 35 degrees; natural warm daylight from upper left, restrained colors, fine readable silhouette, not cartoon, no pixel art. COLUMN DIRECTIONS relative to the image: col1 EAST facing RIGHT profile; col2 SOUTHEAST facing bottom-right; col3 SOUTH facing down toward viewer, full front; col4 SOUTHWEST facing bottom-left; col5 WEST facing LEFT profile; col6 NORTHWEST facing top-left, back three-quarter; col7 NORTH facing up away from viewer, full BACK of head and coat; col8 NORTHEAST facing top-right, back three-quarter. These eight orientations are essential, including the true back views, NOT eight copies of the front. ROWS are FOUR sequential looping walk phases for each direction: left foot forward, passing stance, right foot forward, opposite passing stance. Modest slow stride; torso and carried load steady. Every cell has feet centered at x=128,y=205 relative to its cell; adult height around 156px. Keep the same body scale in every cell, all props fit entirely within its cell with at least 12px transparent margin. Cart changes orientation WITH person and stays ahead in all eight directions; if not a cart sprite, do not add a cart. No cast shadows outside cell, no cut-off limbs, no background, no UI. Deliver a clean precisely aligned sprite atlas, all 32 complete figures.
